name: fractal-factory-invariant-meta-knowledge-redesign
versionNote: All planned prompt and documentation changes implemented; final status snapshot.
description: Redesign the Fractal Factory meta-knowledge architecture so cross-run memory stores only curated invariant-handling heuristics, process patterns, and reusable strategies.
designDecisions: Raw invariants remain run-local domain artifacts rather than persistent meta-knowledge entries.
Invariant-related cross-run memory is allowed only when abstracted into reusable heuristics, verification strategies, or recurring failure modes.
Prompt-level enforcement comes first: reference architecture, templates, analyzers, and integrator must all encode the same boundary.

phases.name: Architecture Boundary
phases.description: Clarify docs so cross-run meta-knowledge excludes raw invariant inventories.

phases.name: Prompt Constraint Rollout
phases.description: Constrain synthesis prompts to accept only abstracted invariant heuristics.

phases.name: Template Alignment
phases.description: Align produced-system meta-knowledge templates with the new boundary.

tasks.title: Clarify meta-knowledge boundary
acceptanceCriteria: Reference architecture explicitly forbids storing raw domain-local invariant inventories in meta/.
Reference architecture explicitly allows only abstracted invariant heuristics, strategies, or recurring failure modes.
Positive and negative examples are included.

tasks.title: Align README wording
acceptanceCriteria: README frames meta-knowledge as reusable strategy rather than accumulated domain rules.
README does not imply that raw invariants persist across runs.

tasks.title: Constrain factory signal analyzer
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt forbids raw invariant inventories as signals.
Prompt permits only generalized invariant heuristics, verification strategies, or failure modes.
Prompt contains concrete examples of rejected vs accepted signals.

tasks.title: Constrain context signal analyzer
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt treats invariant observations as process patterns rather than stored rule sets.
Prompt explicitly bans persisting raw invariant content.

tasks.title: Tighten knowledge integrator gate
acceptanceCriteria: Integrator rejects raw domain-local invariant inventories by default.
Integrator allows only tightly abstracted invariant-related entries that pass reusability and actionability.
Prompt includes accepted vs rejected examples.

tasks.title: Align produced-system templates
acceptanceCriteria: Templates forbid raw invariant inventories in domain and context signal analyzers.
Templates make the knowledge integrator reject domain-local invariant catalogs.

tasks.title: Run consistency pass
acceptanceCriteria: All modified files use the same boundary language.
No modified file implies that raw invariant inventories accumulate across runs.
